title: ATRL: Agentic Atelier for Tech Review Letters
summary: A question arising while reading a paper grows through investigation, calculation, writing and review into an explanation; problems encountered along the way return as changes to shared criteria and publishing tools. Using the ATRL atelier as a case, this essay follows how human direction, AEDAUT editorial work and ADOPT operations form one agentic workflow, making the collaborative architecture itself an object of research and creation.
